facts.fact: 她从春芽阁一路恍惚走回家，方才看见听见的东西还在脑子里打转。
facts.anchor: Kiamling walked home in a daze, reeling from everything she had seen and heard at the Pavilion of Spring Buds.

facts.fact: 她骂了一句才摸到灯，划到第四根火柴才把灯点着。
facts.anchor: Swearing, she finally found the lamp, but it took four matches before she was able to light it.

facts.fact: 平常这个时候，妹妹会把晚饭剩下的菜留在火边温着。
facts.anchor: Usually Jingling would have leftovers from dinner warming by the embers of the fire.

facts.fact: 平常祖母会用手杖先戳她的脚，免得她撞到要紧东西。
facts.anchor: Por Por would jab at her feet with a walking stick

facts.fact: 如今这样“平常”的日子再也没有了。
facts.anchor: But there was no usually any more.

facts.fact: 家里几乎没有吃的，只剩豆子、一根胡萝卜、一个洋葱和一个干瘪的红薯。
facts.anchor: There was very little food in the house.

facts.fact: 她随即想起祖母是被拽进裂隙的，困在另一边，说不定已经死了。
facts.anchor: But then she remembered that Por Por had been pulled through a rift – trapped, if not… dead.

facts.fact: 祖母供养女鬼这件事，违背猎妖人的正统教条。
facts.anchor: Something that went against the official teachings of yiugwai hunters.

facts.fact: 多年前她替祖母收拾东西，被藤条抽中手腕，只换来这一句。
她按“剑、家、破、鬼”去对字码，锁纹丝不动。
facts.anchor: The lock resolutely refused to open.

facts.fact: 真正的四字密码是“鬼［不］黑白”，中间那格故意不刻字。
facts.anchor: A negative space in the four character code: ghost [not] black white.
The lock opened with a satisfying click.

facts.fact: 箱子里是右线装的厚本子，全是祖母的笔迹，记着每一笔活计与进账。
facts.anchor: Inside the chest were thick notebooks, stitched on the right-hand side.

facts.fact: 祖母从离开广州那年起，就在按月偿还这笔债。
facts.anchor: Por Por had been paying it off since they had left Canton.

facts.fact: 借据上的债主不是烟馆也不是麻将馆，是广东最大的帮会。
facts.anchor: It was the biggest organised criminal gang in Canton province.

facts.fact: 借据写明这笔钱按月分期付出，用来安置南京城一带流离失所的人。
facts.anchor: Payment in monthly instalments for housing and feeding those displaced around Nanjing city.

facts.fact: 她放不下这些靠祖母的意志才有住有食的人，无法装作不知道。
章末她打定主意：只剩一个太客气、不会追问的人可以开口。
